result:
I shipped one more title change (v31.00), but the title (screen 01) is still scored 3. Your finish line is 4, so this is partial. Preflight and the gate both passed. The seed 4242 fingerprint is unchanged.

- **What shipped:** the saves block is now as wide as the mode buttons (560px, was 898px). The name box shows the default name as "pillager" instead of "PILLAGER". A name you type keeps its letters, and starting a game doesn't save the lowered default as a new name.
- **Critic on screen 01:** 3 of 5, "better than before".
- **Screens 44, 45, 46, 56, 57:** I shot 45 and 46 after the ship but didn't run the critic on them this run. The earlier runs scored 45, 46 and 57 at 3 each. 44 and 56 have no score on record. The remaining findings on 45, 46 and 57 are the attract-card structure (a lone "press any key", a tiny close X, no header or footer), not the backdrop.
- **Live fight and the scoreboard/how-to backdrop:** these shipped in earlier runs (v30.65, v30.69, v30.82).
- **Frame rate:** I have not measured 60 fps at 4K on the title. I have no tool to measure it. The fight is only 2 pillagers and a few robots with no simulation behind it.
- **What is left on 01:** all of it is a ruling of yours, a big restructure or both. Taking any of them would need your call.
  - The five mode rows, which are the rows you ordered.
  - The gold gradient logo. Fixture check 18.11 requires the gradient and the style guide bans it.
  - The fullscreen button.
  - The saves block as a form on the title.
  - The key legend.

Notes are in `notes/03-title-and-backdrop.md` and the change is logged in `notes/ui/changes.md`. Shots are in `shots/03-r6-before` and `shots/03-r6-after`.

TASK PARTIAL: screen 01 is stuck at 3 and needs your call on the logo gradient, the five mode rows and the saves block. I haven't run the critic on 44 and 56, and I haven't measured 60 fps at 4K on the title.
